clue.text: Energetically get one's hands on a few eggs

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to grab or grip something tightly and urgently
second meaning: a set of eggs laid together and incubated in one nest

explanation.surface: Someone eagerly grabbing a handful of eggs, perhaps in a kitchen or a henhouse.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to grasp tightly, and the noun names a batch of eggs a hen sits on at once.

clue.text: Prototype helicopter designer giving old doctor an Xmas spin

indicators.note: to spin something round turns it to face the other way, so the preceding words are read backwards

parts.note: O is the standard abbreviation for old
DR is the usual abbreviation for doctor
the indefinite article, a or an, gives A
Noel is another word for Christmas

explanation.surface: An aircraft designer seems to be taking an old doctor for a festive helicopter ride.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole string O + DR + A + NOEL, read backwards, spells LEONARDO.
explanation.definitionFit: Leonardo da Vinci sketched an aerial screw in his notebooks, often called an early forerunner of the modern rotorcraft.

clue.text: I'm obliged, Harry, to get fresh jam filling — it's a wonder

indicators.note: a filling sits inside something else, as jam does in a sandwich, so these letters go in the middle

parts.note: ta is an informal British way of saying thank you

indicators.note: fresh suggests something made anew, so the following word is rearranged

parts.note: taken as written, then rearranged
Hal is a familiar form of Harry, as with Shakespeare's Prince Hal

explanation.surface: A grateful person thanks Harry for a jam sandwich, declaring it marvellous.
explanation.walkthrough: Ta is British slang for thanks, and Prince Hal is Shakespeare's name for the young Henry V.
explanation.definitionFit: The marble mausoleum at Agra is listed among the New Seven Wonders of the World.

clue.text: Order a treble? Ah, that's refreshing

definitions.note: the phrase stands for a noun: something that refreshes

indicators.note: to order things is to arrange them, so the following letters are put into a new sequence

parts.note: all nine letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: In a pub someone orders a triple measure of spirits, sighing with satisfaction.
explanation.walkthrough: A treble sounds like a triple shot at the bar, but the drink that emerges is caffeine-free and non-alcoholic.
explanation.definitionFit: An infusion of herbs such as mint or camomile is drunk as a reviving, soothing beverage.

clue.text: Python leaving papers in care of quiet, singular Athenian

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for quiet

indicators.note: leaving means departing, so the word for papers walks out of the Python's name

parts.note: Eric Idle was a member of the Monty Python comedy team
identity papers, shortened to ID
S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular

explanation.surface: A Monty Python star abandons his paperwork while looking after a silent lone Greek.
explanation.walkthrough: Python is not a snake but a member of the Monty Python comedy troupe, whose surname loses its papers.
explanation.definitionFit: Pericles was the statesman and general who led Athens during its golden age in the fifth century BC.

clue.text: New hearing implant, electronic, that allowed The Doors to be laid back

definitions.text: that allowed The Doors to be laid back
definitions.note: the phrase stands for a noun: the device that let doors fold back

indicators.note: new suggests a fresh version, so the letters that follow are reworked into another order

parts.note: taken as written, as anagram fodder
E is the standard abbreviation for electronic, as in e-mail

explanation.surface: A new electronic ear implant somehow let the rock band The Doors be so relaxed.
explanation.walkthrough: The Doors sounds like the 1960s rock band and laid back like their mellow mood, but the clue means ordinary doors swung flat against a wall.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of hinge projects from the frame so that a door can swing right round and lie flat against the adjacent wall.

clue.text: Endanger sovereign after evacuating area

indicators.note: evacuating means clearing out, so the letter for area is emptied from the word

parts.note: imperial describes supreme royal rule, like that of a sovereign
A is the standard abbreviation for area

explanation.surface: A monarch is put at risk once a region has been cleared of people.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking the A out of IMPERIAL leaves IMPERIL.
explanation.definitionFit: To imperil means to put someone or something into danger, exactly the sense of the verb to endanger.

clue.text: Genteel boy, extremely youthful former President

parts.note: a lad is a boy

indicators.note: extremely points to the extremes, the very ends, of the following word

parts.note: the first and last letters of youthful
Ike was the nickname of US President Dwight Eisenhower

explanation.surface: A refined, very young lad who resembles an ex-President.
explanation.definitionFit: Genteel and ladylike both describe polite, refined manners associated with proper upbringing.

clue.text: Stephenson's first engine fitted with power wheel with teeth

indicators.note: an engine fitted with a part has it built inside, so a letter is placed within
first asks for only the opening letter of the name before it

parts.note: the opening letter of the engineer's name
P is the symbol for power in physics
Rocket was the famous early steam locomotive built by George Stephenson's firm

explanation.surface: Stephenson's pioneering locomotive is given a powered toothed wheel.
explanation.walkthrough: P goes inside S + ROCKET, just after the S.
explanation.definitionFit: A sprocket is a toothed wheel that engages a chain, as on a bicycle, so it is literally a toothed wheel.

clue.text: One uses tricks to swindle Texas oilman hoarding uranium and gold

parts.note: a con is a swindle

indicators.note: someone hoarding something keeps it stored away inside, so one letter sits within the oilman

parts.note: J.R. Ewing, the scheming oil baron in the TV soap Dallas
U is the chemical symbol for uranium
or is the heraldic word for gold; and just joins it on

explanation.surface: A trickster cheats a Texan oil tycoon who is stockpiling nuclear fuel and bullion.
explanation.walkthrough: Dallas was a 1980s American TV soap about a Texas oil family; its villain is known by his initials.
explanation.definitionFit: A conjuror is a magician who performs sleight-of-hand illusions, so tricks are their trade.

clue.text: Web designer's sophisticated search program

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the creature that spins a web
second meaning: software that crawls the internet indexing pages for a search engine

explanation.surface: A website developer boasts of clever search software.
explanation.walkthrough: Web designer sounds like a job in IT, but it is the eight-legged maker of a web.
explanation.definitionFit: The arachnid builds silk webs, and a web crawler bot used by search engines is also given the same name.

clue.text: A femme fatale, mum starts to tempt admirer by tossing hair

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mum

indicators.note: tossing something about throws it into disorder, so its letters are jumbled
starts points to the opening letters of the next two words

parts.note: the opening letters of tempt and admirer
taken as written, then jumbled

explanation.surface: A seductive woman, perhaps a mother, flicks her hair to lure an admirer.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dutch exotic dancer executed as a spy in 1917 became the archetypal seductive and dangerous woman.

clue.text: Father, religious, excommunicating Catherine in prank

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title

indicators.note: to excommunicate is to expel from the church, so the short form of the name is thrown out of the religious word

parts.note: a Catholic is a member of a religious denomination
Cath is a short form of Catherine

explanation.surface: A devout priest expels a woman called Catherine as part of a practical joke.
explanation.walkthrough: Religious looks like a description of Father, but it is a separate word naming a denomination.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun, a frolic is a playful caper or bit of light-hearted mischief, much like a prank.

clue.text: After the season, plan mutual open-ended returns

definitions.note: a descriptive phrase standing in for an adjective

indicators.note: returns means comes back, so the kept letters are read in the opposite direction
open-ended means the ends are opened up and lost, so only the interior run of letters is kept

parts.note: the two words run together with their outer letters dropped

explanation.surface: Once the holidays are over, people agree a shared plan that is left loose and keeps coming back.
explanation.walkthrough: Strip the first and last letters from planmutual, then read what remains backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Autumnal means belonging to the fall, the quarter of the year that follows summer, or past one's prime.

clue.text: Smartie Pants set up AI plant

indicators.note: pants is British slang for rubbish or badly done, so the word before is reworked

parts.note: taken as written; a Smartie is a sugar-coated chocolate sweet

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up means raised upward, so the two letters are read bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A know-it-all has framed an artificial intelligence system.
explanation.walkthrough: Smartie Pants looks like smarty-pants, a know-all; really Pants is the signal to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Artemisia is a genus of aromatic herbs and shrubs including wormwood, mugwort and tarragon.

clue.text: Pass round women's hood

indicators.note: round means going about the outside, so the pass encircles the letter for women

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
W is the abbreviation for women

explanation.surface: Passing round a woman's hooded garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A cowl is the loose head covering attached to a monk's robe, so a kind of hood.

clue.text: US agents soundly duff up Italian favourite from 20 Across

parts.note: the CIA is the American intelligence agency

indicators.note: soundly means by sound, so the spoken form counts rather than the spelling

parts.note: to duff up is British slang for beating someone, so batter, which in a non-rhotic accent ends like a

explanation.surface: American spies thoroughly beat up a popular Italian bought at the bakers.
explanation.walkthrough: 20 Across is BAKERS, so the definition is a favourite Italian bread from the bakery.
explanation.definitionFit: Ciabatta is a flat, airy white loaf from Italy, now a staple item sold in bakeries everywhere.

clue.text: Like the most weird, most Dastardly race?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: superlative of an informal word for crazy or eccentric
second meaning: playful, as the most Wacky of races, the cartoon in which Dick Dastardly was the cheating villain

explanation.walkthrough: Wacky Races was a 1960s American cartoon of madcap car races in which the villain Dick Dastardly always tried to cheat.
explanation.definitionFit: Wacky means zany or odd, so its superlative fits strangest; the race pun treats the cartoon title as a comparison.

clue.text: Soccer trifecta lands sure-fire winner

indicators.note: lands suggests the words hold or contain something within their territory, so the answer is inside them

parts.note: found across the end of the first word and start of the second

explanation.surface: A bet predicting three football results comes good and pays out.
explanation.walkthrough: A trifecta is a bet picking the first three finishers in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Cert is a British colloquial shortening of certainty, used for a horse or team regarded as bound to win.

clue.text: Bill goes by bike around a group of islands

indicators.note: around means encircling, so the riding phrase wraps about the bill

parts.note: to cycle is to travel by bicycle
an ad, or advertisement, is a bill posted up

explanation.surface: A man called Bill tours an archipelago on his bicycle.
explanation.walkthrough: Bill looks like a man's name but is a poster.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cyclades are an archipelago in the Aegean Sea, including Mykonos, Naxos and Santorini.

clue.text: Clergyman finished swallowing large piece

parts.note: Rev is short for reverend, a clergyman

indicators.note: something swallowed ends up inside, so the letter for large goes within the word for finished

parts.note: over means ended or finished
L is the clothing abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A vicar has eaten up a big slice of something.
explanation.walkthrough: Piece is slang for a gun, not a slice of cake.
explanation.definitionFit: Piece is a slang term for a handgun, and a revolver is a pistol with a rotating cylinder.

clue.text: Social network adopted by former PM as chief support

indicators.note: something adopted is taken into a family, so the network goes inside the name

parts.note: Theresa May was UK Prime Minister from 2016 to 2019
Insta is short for Instagram

explanation.surface: An ex-Prime Minister takes up a social media platform as her main crutch.
explanation.definitionFit: A mainstay is the key prop or pillar something depends upon; originally the rope holding the mainmast.

clue.text: Fantastic female compiler, married, held in police operation

parts.note: the compiler is the setter, who refers to themself as me

indicators.note: held in means kept inside, so the letter for married is kept within the police operation

parts.note: a raid is a police swoop
M is the abbreviation for married

explanation.surface: A brilliant woman setter, newly wed, is detained in a police sting.
explanation.walkthrough: Fantastic means imaginary here, not wonderful.
explanation.definitionFit: A mermaid is a mythical sea creature, half woman and half fish, so a female from fantasy.

clue.text: Rolls manufacturers?

parts.note: surface reading: makers of Rolls-Royce luxury cars
setter's reading: small bread loaves, and those who make them

explanation.walkthrough: The capital R makes it look like the car marque; it is just bread rolls.
explanation.definitionFit: Bread rolls are produced by people who make bread and cakes for a living.

clue.text: American in Paris maybe a West End smash

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation for American inside the surname

parts.note: Paris Hilton is an example of someone with this surname
Am is the abbreviation for American

explanation.surface: An American in Paris, perhaps, was a hit musical in London's theatre district.
explanation.walkthrough: Paris is not the city but the celebrity Paris Hilton.
explanation.definitionFit: Hamilton, Lin-Manuel Miranda's hip-hop musical, has been a long-running hit in London's theatreland.

clue.text: Upper hides round hole in one part of shoe

indicators.note: something that hides another keeps it concealed within, so the word for upper wraps around

parts.note: the top is the upper part

indicators.note: round suggests turning about, so the golfing term is turned to face the other way

parts.note: in golf, an ace is a hole completed with a single stroke

explanation.surface: A shoe's upper conceals a round hole in one of its parts.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'in one' that seems to locate the hole is part of the golf phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A toecap is the reinforced covering over the front of a boot or shoe, one component of footwear.

clue.text: Reportedly is aware of seedy bar in which a drop is pretty steep

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said, so the phrase counts by sound not spelling

parts.note: knows means is aware of, and is said the same way as the facial feature
a dive is a disreputable drinking place

explanation.surface: Word has it someone knows a grotty bar where the prices are steep.
explanation.walkthrough: Pretty steep sounds like a price complaint about the bar, but it describes a plunge.
explanation.definitionFit: A nosedive is a sudden steep plunge by an aircraft or, figuratively, a sharp fall in value.

clue.text: Cure against deer being pierced by tick initially

parts.note: anti means against

indicators.note: something pierced has another thing driven into it, so a letter goes inside the deer

parts.note: a doe is a female deer

indicators.note: initially points to only the opening letter of the word before

parts.note: the opening letter of tick

explanation.surface: A remedy for a deer bitten by a tick, a parasite that latches on.
explanation.definitionFit: An antidote is a remedy that counteracts a poison, so it is a cure.

clue.text: Ridiculous sailors' uniform ruched at the edges

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is a sailor, so ABS is sailors
Uniform is the NATO phonetic alphabet word for U

indicators.note: the edges are the outer ends, so only the first and last letters of the word are kept

parts.note: the first and last letters of ruched

explanation.surface: Sailors' uniforms gathered in frills at the hem look laughable.
explanation.walkthrough: Uniform looks like clothing, but stands for its letter in the phonetic alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Absurd means wildly unreasonable or silly, a close synonym of ridiculous or laughable.
